offer: The reconstructed sequence changes the account you gave Holly. Call her with what the evidence now supports — and what it still does not establish.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Holly, I need to correct what I told you about John. The later records and Alex's account change the picture.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Not his location. We established that he prepared an escape and left the aircraft under a parachute before it crashed. He used the crash to cover his disappearance.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: The line remains connected. Holly says nothing.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Yes. I am here. I just... need a moment.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Then he did not die in that crash.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: He escaped before impact. I still do not know where he went or what happened afterwards.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: I understand. Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: The call ends without the questions you expected. Her silence is something you noticed, not proof of why she reacted that way.

objective: Speak to Holly about continuing the search and obtaining a financial lead.

messages.complete: Holly has been told about John's staged disappearance. Next: discuss continuing the search and a financial lead.
